about: Tactics and Strategy say only what their boards show. Graded by gate 175 (TC-R246a..d) on a trial bundle at 375x761 with his insets and at 320x568: every legal wrong move of all 13 Tactics cards is played and its line is never the bare fixed line, is true where it names a mate or a piece hung, and is wholly inside its box; a tap that is no legal move says so; each chess claim in a Tactics idea, hint, explanation and wrong-try line, and in each of the 18 Strategy cards' look line and text, is checked against the position with the app's rules and this gate's own attack count; and the screen shows the row's words and board. NOT COVERED HERE: the engine questions (the stored moves are best, the open-file invasion works, the bishop pair is a small edge) are gate 129, TC-R205a..e, which runs Stockfish in node and has no screen situation; general advice with no position claim; the sideways and desktop layouts, which draw the same line in another box; his phone.

breaks.name: fixed-line-back
breaks.why: the card's own line is dropped: a wrong move the board proves nothing about, and a tap that is no legal move, read 'Not the key move. Try again.' again (213 of the 238 legal wrong moves)

breaks.name: open-file-no-luft
breaks.why: Put rooks on open files goes back to the board without h3, where the invasion its text promises loses: Rc7 allows Rd1 mate and Rc8+ drops the rook

breaks.name: line-cut-on-a-short-phone
breaks.why: the wrong-try line is no longer scrolled to the top of its box, so at 320x568 its second line is cut at the box's foot under the card's name
